subject: english
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Speaking disrespectfully about sacred or religious things.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Blasphemy"** means speaking disrespectfully about sacred or religious things. (ईशनिंदा)

 
 
• **Example: **His speech was considered blasphemy by the religious community.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Mystic **(रहस्यवादी): Someone who seeks, through contemplation and self-surrender, to obtain unity with or absorption into the Deity or the absolute, or who believes in the spiritual apprehension of truths that are beyond the intellect.

 
 
• **Example:** The mystic spent years meditating in the mountains, seeking enlightenment.
 
 
 
• **Atheist **(नास्तिक): A person who disbelieves or lacks belief in the existence of God or gods.
 
 
• **Example: **The atheist challenged the religious doctrines during the debate.
 
 
 
• **Theist** (आस्तिक): A person who believes in the existence of a god or gods, specifically of a creator who intervenes in the universe.
 
 
• **Example:** The theist regularly attended church services and believed in divine intervention.
 
 

34:T96e,

The correct answer is: **Option 1**.
